hero.title: About Us
hero.subtitle: Our passion for baking, your daily bread

baker.title: Meet the Baker
baker.name: Yuki Tanaka
baker.bio: With over 20 years of experience in artisan bread making, Yuki brings a unique blend of traditional Japanese techniques and European craftsmanship to every loaf.
baker.philosophy: Every bread tells a story. From the careful selection of ingredients to the patient fermentation process, I believe in honoring the craft that has been passed down through generations.

quality.title: Quality Ingredients
quality.description: We source the finest flours, grains, and natural ingredients from trusted local and international suppliers.

traditional.title: Traditional Methods
traditional.description: Our breads are crafted using time-honored techniques including long fermentation and natural yeast cultivation.

love.title: Made with Love
love.description: Every loaf is handcrafted with care and attention to detail, ensuring the highest quality in every bite.

story.title: Our Story
story.paragraph1: Bread Kitchen began as a small home bakery in 2016, born from a passion for authentic artisan bread making.
story.paragraph2: What started as weekend baking sessions for friends and family has grown into a beloved local institution, serving fresh bread to our community every week.
story.paragraph3: We remain committed to our founding principles: quality ingredients, traditional methods, and bread made with love.
